careerResult.directionSummary: Your strongest career alignment is with {career}, with related paths to explore.
careerResult.calculationBody: Each answer is 1 to 5 and is normalized with (answer - 1) / 4. Normalized answers are averaged within each of the 8 dimensions. The resulting 8-dimensional learner vector is compared with 11 fixed career reference vectors using mean absolute difference (L1 distance). Similarity is 1 minus mean absolute difference; fit percentage is similarity times 100. This deterministic mathematical similarity algorithm identifies the highest-aligned career profiles.

prompt_engineering.title: Prompt Engineering & LLM Workflows
prompt_engineering.description: Design, test, and improve prompts and multi-step large language model (LLM) workflows for useful, verifiable outcomes.

ai_automation_n8n.title: AI Automation with n8n
ai_automation_n8n.description: Build maintainable n8n workflows that connect events, APIs, AI model calls, and human decisions.

vibe_coding.title: Vibe Coding: Build & Ship Apps with AI
vibe_coding.description: Use AI coding assistants to prototype and ship apps while retaining control through specifications, inspection, testing, and security checks.

generative_ai_llm.title: Generative AI & LLM Application Development
generative_ai_llm.description: Build large language model (LLM) applications using model APIs, structured outputs, embeddings, conversation state, and practical reliability controls.

rag_knowledge_systems.title: RAG & Knowledge Systems
rag_knowledge_systems.description: Build grounded knowledge assistants with document ingestion, chunking, retrieval, citations, and evaluation.

ai_agents.title: AI Agents & Tool Use
ai_agents.description: Design bounded agent loops that use tools, manage state, and recover safely from errors.

mcp_tool_connected_ai.title: MCP & Tool-Connected AI
mcp_tool_connected_ai.description: Connect AI applications to external capabilities using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), server-provided tools/resources, and explicit permissions.

ai_software_engineering.title: AI-Powered Software Engineering
ai_software_engineering.description: Apply AI across requirements, architecture, coding, testing, review, documentation, and release with engineering controls.

ai_evaluation.title: AI Evaluation & Reliability
ai_evaluation.description: Evaluate AI behavior with representative cases, groundedness checks, regression suites, safety controls, and operational monitoring.
